bootstrap.interval_rule: Observed estimate plus/minus the simultaneous max-t critical value times that estimate's bootstrap standard deviation; no clipping.
bootstrap.method: Speaker-cluster bootstrap with replacement, preserving all paired rows within each resampled speaker.
bootstrap.rng: Python random.Random (MT19937), randrange(10) repeated 10 times per bootstrap replicate.

limitations: The full-support comparisons are diagnostic summaries of this completed controls ledger, not candidate qualification or method selection.
The strict attestation QC validates self-hashed per-row references; the six-file transfer QC did not separately download all 360 referenced native receipt files.
The simultaneous intervals are approximate cluster-bootstrap intervals over ten frozen speaker clusters.

support_availability_summary.guard20_interpretation: Actual emitted support_by_support.guard20 fields; eligibility was not inferred from the support label. Query counts are scored query positions, not video frame counts.

terminal_readback_context.native_receipt_download_scope: The downloaded attestation's self-hashed per-row references are checked; the 360 referenced receipt files are not separately downloaded by this six-file QC.
terminal_readback_context.repeat_policy: NOT_RUN_SUBRUN; all 360 original result rows remain present
